input: Optional raw-byte Viper Set override, optional explicitly changed feature-gates flag, and the FEATURE_GATES environment effect.
output: Result<FeatureGates, FeatureGateError>, through the production raw query parser.
preconditions: The command option parser supplies Some only for an explicitly changed flag, including an empty value. Full parsing of unrelated command options remains a required command-layer surface.
The source-bound OS/string semantics are Linux/amd64. Other platforms' OsString encodings are not credited as original Go byte-string equivalence.
postconditions: Set override precedes a changed flag; both preserve explicit empty values.
With no explicit override, read FEATURE_GATES once. A missing or empty environment value selects the empty source default.
Pass the selected raw bytes to the existing CGP parser. A rejected selected input returns its typed error without retry or lower-priority fallback.

Fallible configured constructors initialize consumers only after successful configuration. Default infallible constructors reject invalid process configuration by panic, corresponding to the source startup Must boundary; the exact application fatal/logging boundary remains lifecycle work.
ordering: No environment read occurs when an explicit override or changed flag is present. This preserves Viper find's effect order.
consistency: An owned copy is read per initialization. There is no claim of a multi-service snapshot across separate loads while the external process environment changes.
duplicates: The command parser resolves repeated flag assignments before supplying the changed value; URL duplicate-key semantics remain the query parser's responsibility.
retry_and_error_classes: Synchronous query errors propagate unchanged. No retry, fallback, scheduling, or asynchronous effect is introduced.
cancellation_and_resource_ownership: The operation creates no tasks or long-lived resource. The process environment reader performs one synchronous read and never mutates shared process environment. The application lifecycle still owns startup and cleanup policy.
validation: One unchanged shared configuration provider runs in the process context and a downstream deterministic captured-input context.
The captured input effect counts reads and checks precedence, empty values, typed invalid raw-byte errors, and no fallback.
Isolated subprocesses exercise actual missing, empty, valid, invalid and raw-byte environment values without mutating the parallel test runner's environment.
Production subprocess integration reaches default and configured GameServer, FleetAutoscaler, admission, and actual SDK sidecar environment construction.
uncredited_boundaries: OS environment implementation, full command option parsing, complete process lifecycle, exact fatal/error rendering, live-cluster transport/conformance, and all remaining baseline behavior.
